<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F2F1F1"/>

  <!-- Device status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="21" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#02060C">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="20" x2="326" y2="14" stroke="#02060C" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="20" x2="331" y2="11" stroke="#02060C" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="336" y1="20" x2="336" y2="8" stroke="#02060C" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="16" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#02060C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="346" y1="20" x2="354" y2="20" stroke="#02060C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="10" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#02060C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="12" width="14" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#02060C"/>
  <rect x="386" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#02060C"/>

  <!-- Product detail behind overlay -->
  <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="364" fill="#F2F1F1"/>
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="65" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="36,58 29,65 36,72" fill="none" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="29" y1="65" x2="42" y2="65" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="359" cy="65" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="61" r="2" fill="#282C3F"/>
    <circle cx="359" cy="65" r="2" fill="#282C3F"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="69" r="2" fill="#282C3F"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="108" y="86" width="174" height="240" rx="12" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <circle cx="243" cy="116" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polygon points="218,286 244,241 268,286" fill="#AA7455"/>
  <polygon points="138,286 187,209 232,286" fill="#736E6E"/>
  <circle cx="236" cy="133" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="358" width="390" height="180" rx="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="28" y="397" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#282C3F">Submariner Date</text>
  <text x="28" y="423" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#736E6E">Oystersteel · Black dial</text>
  <text x="28" y="462" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#282C3F">$14,250</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="206" y="442" width="154" height="48" rx="8" fill="#AA7455"/>
    <text x="283" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Buy Now</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation behind modal -->
  <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,795 48,787 57,795 57,806 39,806" fill="none" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="35,795 48,783 61,795" fill="none" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#282C3F">Home</text>
    <circle cx="144" cy="793" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="151" y1="800" x2="157" y2="806" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="144" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#282C3F">Explore</text>
    <rect x="222" y="785" width="16" height="17" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="790" x2="235" y2="790" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="230" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#282C3F">Orders</text>
    <circle cx="328" cy="789" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="328" cy="804" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="328" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#282C3F">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Dimming layer -->
  <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="812" fill="#000000" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Address bottom sheet shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="0" y="347" width="390" height="500" rx="30" fill="#282C3F" opacity="0.18"/>
  <rect x="0" y="344" width="390" height="500" rx="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Sheet handle -->
  <rect x="174" y="360" width="42" height="4" rx="2" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

  <text x="28" y="402" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#282C3F">Select delivery address</text>
  <text x="28" y="428" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#736E6E">Choose where you would like your watch delivered</text>

  <!-- First address -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="34" cy="467" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="467" r="4" fill="#AA7455"/>
    <polygon points="61,454 68,454 72,461 68,470 61,470 57,462" fill="none" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="64.5" cy="459" r="1.5" fill="#AA7455"/>
    <text x="84" y="463" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#AA7455">Home</text>
    <text x="84" y="485" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#282C3F">24B, Pali Hill, Bandra West</text>
    <text x="84" y="506" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#736E6E">Mumbai, Maharashtra 400050</text>
    <polyline points="357,474 363,480 357,486" fill="none" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="28" y1="526" x2="362" y2="526" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-opacity="0.1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Second address -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="34" cy="558" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="61,545 68,545 72,552 68,561 61,561 57,553" fill="none" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="64.5" cy="550" r="1.5" fill="#AA7455"/>
    <text x="84" y="554" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#AA7455">Work</text>
    <text x="84" y="576" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#282C3F">Level 12, One BKC, Bandra East</text>
    <text x="84" y="597" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#736E6E">Mumbai, Maharashtra 400051</text>
    <polyline points="357,565 363,571 357,577" fill="none" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="28" y1="617" x2="362" y2="617" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-opacity="0.1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Add new address -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="34" cy="650" r="16" fill="#282C3F" opacity="0.05"/>
    <line x1="27" y1="650" x2="41" y2="650" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="34" y1="643" x2="34" y2="657" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="62" y="656" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#AA7455">Add a new address</text>
    <polyline points="357,644 363,650 357,656" fill="none" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <text x="28" y="700" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#736E6E">Your address is used only for delivery and order updates.</text>

  <!-- Done button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="750" width="328" height="48" rx="8" fill="#AA7455"/>
    <text x="195" y="780" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Done</text>
  </g>
</svg>
